resources.string: Lets the assistant you asked use apps for you — tap, type and scroll — and stops on payment or password screens.

Action Mode lets AmitAI carry out the task you typed: open an app, read what is on screen, tap a button, type into a search box, scroll. It only runs while you have Action Mode on, it shows an ongoing notification with a Stop button while it works, and it stops immediately on password, OTP, banking and payment screens. AmitAI never reads your passwords, never completes financial transactions, and never answers Android permission dialogs for you. You can turn this off at any time in Settings › Accessibility.
